page_title: ATA 0-3 SAS | Atalanta v Sassuolo 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Atalanta are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
90+2' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:1.
90+1' Substitution. Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) on for Andrea Pinamonti.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Fabio Grosso decides to make a substitution. Ismael Kone will be replaced by Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo).
90' Here's the change. Domenico Berardi leaves the pitch and Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) comes on as a substitute.
89' Sassuolo hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
87' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
87' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
85' Close! Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
83' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Davide Zappacosta walks off.
83' Total attempts – 11:8.
81' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Josh Doig (Sassuolo) replaces Fali Cande.
81' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fali Cande (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Valerio Crezzini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) is replacing Ademola Lookman.
77' Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
76' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) plays a through ball but overhits it.
74' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
73' Atalanta are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
71' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
70' The possession of the ball – 67:33.
68' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
66' 0 - 3 Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the middle of the goal.
65' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
64' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
62' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) makes a strong challenge and Valerio Crezzini blows for a foul.
60' Here is a change. Alieu Fadera is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
58' The game has come to an end for Nikola Krstovic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
57' The game is interrupted as Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is flagged offside.
56' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.

55' What a miss! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
53' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
52' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
51' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

51' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Arijanet Muric, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' The Atalanta players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
48' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.

47' 0 - 2 Goal Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo)! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) was put through by Domenico Berardi and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 0:2.
46' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Ederson is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
46' Ivan Juric has made a change at the break. Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) has come on in place of Odilon Kossounou.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' PENALTY APPEAL after Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45+3' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+1' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
43' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Valerio Crezzini saw the whole situation.
42' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
41' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 5:2.
39' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
37' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) commits a foul and Valerio Crezzini immediately signals a free kick.
36' Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

35' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) goes on a great individual run, arrives at the edge of the box and pulls the trigger. It was a promising effort which would have most likely gone past the goalkeeper if it hadn't been deflected by another offensive player.
33' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' The total number of attempts is 2:3.
29' 0 - 1 Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) takes the penalty and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom right corner!
29' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

28' Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for an infringement. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Sassuolo!
26' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
25' A cross into the box from Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is cleared.
23' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
22' The percentage of ball possession is – 65:35.
20' Dangerous play by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta). Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
18' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
17' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
15' Flag goes up against Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
11' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
10' The game is interrupted now, Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
9' A lofted pass picks out Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
7' Some patient build-up play from Atalanta as they look to unlock the defence.
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
3' Sassuolo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

1' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sassuolo.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Sassuolo will take the kick-off.
Valerio Crezzini is the one to supervise the game today.
